source_title: Justin Long Joins Jenna Ortega, Rose Byrne in Drama ‘Nasty’ (Exclusive)
source_excerpt:
Justin Long has joined Jenna Ortega and Rose Byrne in Nasty , a drama that Mary Bronstein is directing for Warner Bros.’s specialty label, Clockwork.
LuckyChap’s Tom Ackerley, Bronte Payne and Morgan Begg are producing along with Ortega.
Written by Isabella Jarosz, Nasty , which is a working title, tells of a prodigious athlete who, while battling for a spot on the Olympic gymnastics team, must overcome her biggest opponent: her coach. Ortega is the talented gymnast, while Byrne is the maternal yet manipulative and exploitative coach. Long will play Byrne’s brother, the team’s co-coach who is popular with the gymnasts but has a hidden dark side.
Jarosz’ script was on the 2024 Black List and has been described by some as a “ Black Swan in the world of competitive gymnastics.” And the project is notable as it reunites Byrne with Bronstein following the actress’ Academy Award-nominated performance in If I Had Legs I’d Kick You , which the filmmaker directed.
Nasty is due to begin shooting mid-November in New Orleans.
Long recently stole scenes with a turn in Zach Cregger’s breakout horror movie Barbarian and was seen in a cameo in the filmmaker’s Weapons . The actor, who also led the first season of Hulu/Disney+ Goosebumps adaptation, will next be seen in Amazon MGM’s rom-com You Deserve Each Other opposite Penn Badgley and Meghann Fahy. That movie is due to hit in January.
He is repped by Independent Artist Group and Yorn Levine.
